create_ShortConvolution: create a ShortConvolution layer with a given hidden size, kernel size, and silu activation
call_ShortConvolution_forward: call the forward method of ShortConvolution on a tensor with optional mask and cache
call_ShortConvolution_step: call the step method of ShortConvolution to decode one token at a time using cache
create_canon: create a canon ShortConvolution module from a dimension and config object with kernel and bias settings
apply_canon: apply a canon convolution to hidden states with caching, masking, and optional residual connection
